title: 2nd Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2/1/2026).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 2025/3/25 to 2025/3/28).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for membership of the Elections Commission, under Article 4(b) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021) for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of Serbia is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of Malta is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Madaveli MP Mohamed Shameez.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir.
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the Bill to amend the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes, send an Elections Commission nominee and two ambassador nominations to committee, introduce the National Service Bill and two Employment Act amendments, and take up the committee report on the Constitution amendment bill.
